content.short: GoPlus Token Security API provides Web3 security data and automated security services.
content.description: GoPlus Token Security API is a key component of GoPlus security infrastructure for Web3, delivering open, permissionless, user-driven security services. It builds security data infrastructure and a security service platform to make the Web3 ecosystem safer. The API provides readily accessible security data to everyone and aims to protect core user experiences such as tokens, addresses, approvals, and signatures through fully automated, dynamic security APIs.
